site_number: LAND BY BY ST LAWRENCE RC PRIMARY SCHOOL
description: Erection of a single storey community cabin for use of Friends of Feltham Green and available to hire by other local groups.
site_name: St. Lawrence R C Primary School
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( J066: PRESf B, PRES*, PREW B, PRES4 B, PREE B, PREN B, PRES B, PREW*, PREWf B, PRPS B, PRS1 B, PRS2 B, PRS3 B, MH7974-001 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Prior to first occupation/use of the development hereby approved, a community use agreement to form part of the lease arrangements shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The agreement shall apply to the entire premises hereby permitted and include details of pricing policy, hours of use, access by non-members of the principal leaseholder, associated management responsibilities, a strategy for marketing and advertisement and a mechanism for review. The development shall not be used at any time other than in strict compliance with the approved agreement.
Condition : 4 - Before the premises are first brought into use, the developer shall provide no less than three short term use 'Sheffield' style cycle parking stands on the forecourt of the premises and a further two long term use 'Sheffield' style cycle parking spaces at the rear of the premises.  The latter are to be enclosed by a secure, roofed and lockable enclosure.  These arrangements shall be retained permanently and kept available for users of the premises.  They shall comply in design and layout with the Westtrans 'West London Cycle Parking Guidance' 2017
Condition : 5 - The premises shall not be occupied until such time as a landscaping contract has been let with a completion date no later than the first available planting season after completion of the built works and all the landscaping works as shown on drawing number MH7974-001, both on the application site and the adjacent land owned by the occupant shall be completed within that timetable.  Any plants or trees that die or are irretrievably damaged within five years of the date of completion of the landscaping works shall be replaced with comparable specimens during the next available planting season after such occurrence
Condition : 6 - The trees identified for retention in the submitted Arboricultural Report 'Feltham Green Cabin' amended April 2022 shall be protected in accordance with the recommendations in that report for the duration of clearance, building and landscaping works on the site.

Condition : 7 - All of the proposed new hard surfaces shown in drawing reference MH7974-001, both within the application site and on the adjacent land owned by the applicant shall comprise permeable surfaces that enable surface water to drain into the subsoil on the site and adjacent land.
Condition : 8 - The premises shall not be brought into use before a management strategy has been devised (with relevant advice - e.g. from the police) and submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to ensure that the forecourt and its associated seating areas are appropriately laid out, managed and supervised to prevent them being used for anti-social behaviour.  The measures so approved shall be put into effect on first occupation and kept in operation thereafter.
Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the approved details, before work begins above ground level revised details to provide additional protection to withstand bumps and knocks to the lower part of the exterior walls shall first have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The details so approved shall be implemented as part of the development before it is brought into use
Condition : 10 - No work shall start on site until including any works of demolition, until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. The Plan shall include:
i. a site plan
ii. confirmation that a pre-start record of site conditions on the adjoining public highway will be undertaken with Hounslow Highways and a commitment to repair any damage caused
iii. provision for the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors 
iv. provisions for loading, unloading and storage of plant and materials within the site
v. details of access to the site, including means to control and manage access and egress of vehicles to and from the site for the duration of construction including phasing arrangements 
vi. details of vehicle routeing from the site to the wider strategic road network
vii. the erection and maintenance of security hoarding including decorative displays and facilities for public viewing, where appropriate 
viii. provision of wheel washing facilities at the site exit and a commitment to sweep adjacent roads when required and at the request of the council
ix. a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works
x. appropriate vehicle routes to and from the site
xi. measures to ensure the safety of all users of the public highway especially cyclists and pedestrians in the vicinity of the site and especially at the access
xii. commitment to liaise with other contractors in the vicinity of the site to maximise the potential for consolidation and to minimise traffic impacts.
xiii. avoidance of peak hours for deliveries and details of a booking system to avoid vehicles waiting on the public highway
All work on site shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
